description: This file contains the entry point and core logic for a database migration runner, which executes Flyway-style SQL migration scripts against a PostgreSQL database. It includes argument parsing, environment variable loading, migration discovery, and execution of SQL scripts within transactions, as well as maintaining a custom migration history table.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Contains the application's entry point and main logic for running migrations without Docker, including args parsing, environment loading, and invoking migration application flow.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsRequest
classes.description: Encapsulates parameters for migration application, including database connection info, migration directory, and dry-run flag.

classes.name: ApplyMigrationsResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of applying migrations, including counts of applied and skipped migrations.

classes.name: MigrationFile
classes.description: Represents a discovered migration script with version, description, and file info.

classes.name: MigrationDiscovery
classes.description: Provides logic to discover and parse migration files in a directory, sorting them in order.

classes.name: MigrationChecksum
classes.description: Utility for computing sha256 checksum of migration SQL scripts.

classes.name: MigrationHistory
classes.description: Manages reading and writing migration application records to the migration history table.

classes.name: DatabaseUrlParser
classes.description: Converts PostgreSQL URL connection strings into Npgsql-compatible connection strings.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main entry point, calls argument parsing and runs migration flow.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists.

methods.name: CliParsing.Parse
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments into a migration request object.

methods.name: CliParsing.ResolveMigrationsPath
methods.description: Resolves the migrations directory path based on input or default locations.

methods.name: CliParsing.NormalizeEnvValue
methods.description: Cleans environment variable values by trimming quotes.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsFlow.RunAsync
methods.description: Performs the migration process: connecting to DB, ensuring history table, discovering pending migrations, and applying them within transactions.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsFlow.ResolveConnectionString
methods.description: Chooses the correct connection string based on input, preferring explicit connection string, else parsing DATABASE_URL.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsFlow.EnsureHistoryTableAsync
methods.description: Creates the migration history table if it does not exist.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsFlow.ExecuteSqlAsync
methods.description: Executes SQL scripts against the database within a transaction.

methods.name: MigrationDiscovery.Discover
methods.description: Discovers and sorts migration scripts based on Flyway naming convention.

methods.name: MigrationDiscovery.TryParse
methods.description: Parses individual files to determine if they match the migration filename pattern.

methods.name: MigrationChecksum.ComputeSha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA256 checksum of SQL script content.

methods.name: MigrationHistory.GetAppliedVersionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves set of versions already applied from the history table.

methods.name: MigrationHistory.InsertAppliedAsync
methods.description: Records a migration as applied with relevant metadata.
